title: Masthead ornaments for the four newspaper style families
missing: The code already sorts every outlet into one of four masthead styles and the only thing that distinguishes them is a font stack. Four outlets on the same page are told apart by typeface alone, which is close to not being told apart at all.

consumerSite.playerVisibleUse: The masthead above each outlet's stories on the news front page, and the nameplate at the top of a single publication's page.

jurisdiction.reason: The style a given outlet gets is derived from a hash of its key, not from where it publishes. The same four families serve every jurisdiction.

whyNeeded: Four is a measured number, not a guess: `MASTHEAD_STYLES = 4` in src/presentation/news-front-page.ts, and `styleFor` assigns every outlet to one of them by hashing its key. The consumer already exists and already asks for four distinct looks; it just has nothing to show for them.
requestedBy: art bench and regional scenes thread
alreadySearched: art/manifest/asset_manifest.json — all 126 assets read. 11 environment-plate, 2 environment-master, 1 foreground mask, 1 reference master, the rest character components. Nothing in it is an interface graphic of any kind.
art/requests/asset-requests.json — 29 requests read, including the ten capitols filed tonight. None asks for interface artwork.
art/requests/incoming/ — 15 filed records read. All are environments or figures.
art/regions/regional-scene-places.json — all 23 regions carry a benchRequestId from his Art Bench, so the Bench's own regional asks are accounted for and none of them is this.
find over art/ and public/ for icon or SVG assets — the only SVGs in the project are pose control plates and arm-measurement QA overlays, which are authoring evidence, not shipped interface art.
src/presentation/news-front-page.ts — MASTHEAD_STYLES is 4 and styleFor() hashes the outlet key into that range. The four are real and already assigned.
src/player/news/news.css — the four .pg-news-masthead--0..3 rules exist and each sets only a font-family, one of them adding italic.
notes: Four ornaments, one per existing style family, designed to sit beside a typeset name rather than to contain one. The name is generated and cannot be drawn.

They should read as four different kinds of paper — something plain and local, something broadsheet and formal, something tabloid, something older — so that a player learns to recognize an outlet by sight.
No real newspaper's mark, wordmark or identifying device. These are fictional outlets and must not borrow a real one's identity.
